test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'FLUTE' is written as 'VGFOU' and 'EXILE' is written as 'VORCV'. How will 'BLOOD' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**'FLUTE' is written as 'VGFOU',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0002989384a0b6cd5b9bcbd1c2af3d3d6e9f626ffaa57d73ab75bf2c6d89e26e.png] 

**'EXILE' is written as 'VORCV',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f6bb579c66840f7708d403e02878dde9e2fbb6f3338fc53f7c299633c476a87.png] 

Similarly,

**'BLOOD' can be written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ccf112fafa92153b278ddde796d268d3296762141468974beb2dfb85ace4b45.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "****WLLOY"**.
